ruleName: Playing from outside the teeing area
group: Playing from outside the teeing area
title: Penalty for playing from outside the teeing area
question: If you play your tee shot from outside the teeing area and do not fix the mistake before finishing the hole, what is the penalty in stroke play?

choices.text: There is no penalty, your shot counts.
You must replay your shot with 2 penalty strokes.
You are disqualified from the competition.
You get a two-stroke penalty but the shot still counts.

explanation: If you fail to correct a tee shot played from outside the teeing area in stroke play, you are disqualified.
